title: Free component of the sign cube split
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x$ assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each coordinate. The restriction of $x$ to $J$ is the first component of the decomposition of $x$ into its restrictions to $J$ and to the complement of $J$.
